title: Broad Bean, Tomato and Persian Lime Khoresh
subtitle: served over white rice
description: A slow-simmered stew of tomatoes, onion, dried Persian limes, prunes and pomegranate molasses, with fresh broad bean pods added for the last half hour. Serve over white rice.

steps.text: Grate the tomatoes, halve and deseed the dried Persian limes, and chop the onions.

Sweat the onions, garlic (or green garlic), paprika and turmeric in the olive oil over medium heat for about 5 minutes. When the onion starts to turn golden, add the Persian limes, prunes, grated tomatoes, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, salt and pepper and bring to the boil.
Lower the heat, cover and cook for 1 hour until the flavours meld and the stew thickens.

Meanwhile, blanch the broad beans: bring water to the boil in a medium pot, squeeze in the halved lemon and add the lemon halves. Add the bean pods and blanch for a few seconds, just until the water returns to the boil. Drain and rinse in plenty of cold water, then keep in a bowl of cold water.
Add the bean pods to the stew and cook for another 30 minutes. Pour over white rice and serve.
